_Install_ the core in the clicked thruster.
While the thruster is producing thrust

item.createpropulsion.super_bucket.toolt: _Copies_ fluids for _infinite_ placement and container filling. An empty bucket can also _empty_ fluid containers.
Right-click fluid or a filled container (empty bucket)

_Clear_ the bucket's selection without changing the container.
Crouch + right-click a filled container (empty bucket)
_Empty_ the container and discard its fluid. The bucket stays _empty_.

createpropulsion.ponder.shared.redstone_: Input on one side increases transmission shift.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.liquid_bu: Liquid Burners also support thermostat redstone control.

createpropulsion.ponder.shared.burner.co: With thermostat override, fuel is consumed continuously.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.redstone_: Full signal gives full configured transmission output.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.liquid_bu: Liquid Burners can be chained with adjacent systems.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.burner.ef: Maintain good fuel and setup to keep burner efficiency high.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.liquid_bu: Liquid Burners consume valid liquid fuels to produce heat.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.redstone_: Incremental mode changes shift level step-by-step.
Direct mode maps input signal directly to output ratio.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.solid_bur: Solid Burners can generate heat for compatible machines above them.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.stirling_: A Stirling Engine runs when heated from below.
Heat from below makes the engine generate rotational force.
Without heat, the engine stops producing speed.
Powering the clutch stops the pump, fuel flow stops, and the engine winds down.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.liquid_bu: They can pass fluid through while operating as burners.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.redstone_: Use the value panel to switch control modes.
Stronger side wins and shifts output accordingly.
If both sides are powered, net change depends on signal difference.
Output scales proportionally with received redstone strength.

createpropulsion.turpentine_bucket.toolt: Fuel for Thrusters. Hold Alt to see thrust and burn rate summary.
createpropulsion.coral_bucket.tooltip.su: Fuel for Coral Generator. Hold Alt to see conversion rate.
createpropulsion.hydrazine_bucket.toolti: Boosts the thrust of _RCS Thrusters_ when pumped into their base. _Toxic_ to touch.
createpropulsion.oxidizer_bucket.tooltip: High-energy fluid used to stabilize and power large multiblock thrusters.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.thruster_: Thrusters accept configured fuels through connected pipes.
Invalid fluids do not power the thruster.
Use valid thruster fuels in the input line.
Now apply redstone power so the thruster actually produces thrust.
2x2 multiblocks only accept fluid from the rear intake side.
A 2x2x2 multiblock is built from 8 normal thrusters.
First line (no clutch) is invalid here: it is not pumping into the rear intake.
Because this line does not feed the rear tanks, the thruster does nothing.
You can only feed from the rear side for multiblocks.
Remove the invalid top line and feed from the rear side instead.
You can only feed from the rear side for multiblocks.
With the valid rear-fed line, insert proper thruster fuel.
Finally apply redstone to the thruster: now it actually runs.
3x3 multiblocks follow the same rear-intake-only rule.
A 3x3x3 multiblock is built from 27 normal thrusters.
You can only feed from the rear side for multiblocks.
Feed the back layer input manifold for full operation.
Insert valid thruster fuel into the rear-fed manifold.
Apply redstone to the thruster and the whole multiblock works.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.solid_fue: The Solid Fuel Thruster burns solid items such as coal and charcoal to produce thrust.
Right-click it with fuel to load one item.
A redstone signal lights the fuel.
Once lit, it keeps burning until the fuel is used up. Turning the signal off does not stop it.
Use a Wrench on it to open the hatch on its back.
With the hatch open, it pulls fuel by itself from any storage behind it, and lights the next item as soon as one burns out.
When the storage runs out of fuel, the thruster stops.
createpropulsion.ponder.vector_core.head: Vector Core
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.vector_co: A thruster pushes from the spot where it is placed. Off the center of the structure, that twists it.
Two thrusters on one side lift that side more than the rest, and the structure flips over.
Install a Vector Core in a thruster by right-clicking it.
With a core, thrust is applied at the center of mass and gravity of the whole structure.
Both thrusters now lift the structure straight up.
Even a single thruster lifts it, with no twist at all.
The core wears out while its thruster produces thrust, faster at higher thrust. A Gyroscopic Mechanism repairs it.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.lidar.int: The Lidar casts a ray straight out of its sensor, up to 64 blocks away.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.lidar.out: When the ray hits something, the Lidar powers the blocks around it, like this lamp. Every side outputs except the sensor.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.lidar.ent: Mobs and players crossing the ray are detected too, which makes it a good tripwire.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.lidar.ana: In Analog mode, closer hits give a stronger signal. In Binary mode, any hit gives full strength.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.lidar.set: Right-click it with an empty hand to choose what the ray detects, and to add a block filter of blocks, buckets or Create filters.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.lidar.inv: With Invert on, the output is flipped: the signal is on while nothing is in the way.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.lidar.com: With CC: Tweaked, a computer can use the Lidar as a peripheral to cast its own rays and scans.
createpropulsion.ponder.rcs_thruster_hyd: Boosting the Full RCS Thruster with Hydrazine
createpropulsion.ponder.single_rcs_thrus: Boosting the Single RCS Thruster with Hydrazine
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.rcs_hydra: RCS Thrusters work on redstone alone, but Hydrazine makes them push much harder.
Without Hydrazine, a full signal pushes with %s pN.
Without Hydrazine, each nozzle pushes with %s pN at full signal.
Hydrazine can only be pumped in through the thruster's base, here on top. It stores up to 1000 mB of its own, so it keeps the boost once the pump is gone.
With Hydrazine inside, the same signal pushes with %s pN.
With Hydrazine inside, each nozzle pushes with %s pN.
Hydrazine is only used while the thruster fires, and less at lower power. When it runs out, thrust drops back to normal.
createpropulsion.ponder.cable_relay.head: Cable Relay
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.cable_rel: Cable Relays link up with their neighbors and carry FE power and redstone signal through the same blocks at the same time.
FE power from any generator travels through the relays to everything connected, here a Vector Thruster.
A redstone signal placed on any relay is carried through the whole chain as well.
No loss. A level %1$s signal is still level %1$s wherever it ends up.
The same goes for any strength, up to the full level %s.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.rcs.intro: The Full RCS Thruster has four nozzles that fire independently, to steer a physics structure in any direction.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.rcs.power: Each nozzle is powered by redstone on its own side, or by its own Redstone Link. It needs no fuel or energy.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.rcs.thrus: Each nozzle gives up to %s pN at full signal strength with default configuration.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.rcs.push: A nozzle pushes the structure in the opposite direction of its exhaust. Fire the opposite nozzle to brake and to come back.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.rcs.diago: Fire two nozzles at once to move diagonally.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.single_rc: The Single RCS Thruster is a small nozzle for steering physics structures.
Power it with redstone or its built-in Redstone Link. It needs no fuel or energy.
As long as it is powered, it pushes constantly: up to %s pN at full signal strength with default configuration.
The thrust pushes the structure in the opposite direction of the exhaust.
A weaker signal, like a lower Analog Lever setting, gives proportionally less thrust.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.coral_gen: The Coral Generator turns Coral fluid into FE power.
Fill it with Coral, by hand or from a pipe. It uses the fluid as long as it has room to store power.
Each mB of Coral gives %s FE.
It outputs power through the two faces it points along, here the top and bottom, to any cable or machine that accepts FE.
Next to a Hydropump and a tank it can feed itself: the pump moves Coral in, and the generator powers the pump.
It holds up to %1$s mB of Coral and %2$s FE.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.hydropump: The Hydropump moves fluids like a Mechanical Pump, but it runs on Forge Energy instead of rotation.
Without a power connection it does nothing. Connect a cable from any FE source.
A Coral Generator turns Coral into FE and outputs power from its top and bottom faces.
Once powered, the Hydropump starts pulling fluid from the tank behind it.
Its pumping speed can be set on the value panel, from 1 to 2000 mB/s.
A low setting moves fluid slowly and uses little power.
A high setting moves fluid quickly but uses more power.
It pumps into anything that accepts fluid, just like a normal pump. Here it feeds the generator.
When power runs out, the pump stops.
createpropulsion.ponder.shared.vector_th: Vector Thruster uses Forge energy to produce thrust.
Forge energy is stored in the thruster's internal energy storage.
Currently %s FE is able to be stored in the thruster's internal storage.
Generators can power from below, this can be anything that uses forge energy system.
Vector Thrusters can rotate in all directions, this is controlled by redstone signals directly embedded into the thruster itself.
A redstone power can be anything from 0-15, this will increase the distance of rotation from the base.
Each side except front and back has a redstone signal place, that direction is where it will be rotated towards when that signal is powered.
Powering a thruster is easy, any external signal to the thruster will be the power, this can range from 0-15, and will use power accordingly.
Creative Vector Thrusters produce configurable thrust without fuel or Forge energy.
Set the creative thrust amount from the value box on the bottom of the thruster.
Creative Vector Thrusters still use redstone power as their throttle, from 0-15.
Liquid Vector Thrusters vector their thrust like normal vector thrusters, but run on pumped liquid fuel.
Pump valid thruster fuel into the liquid vector thruster through the pipe below.
Once fuel is pumped in, the internal tank can feed the thruster while it is powered.
Apply redstone power to throttle the liquid vector thruster, from 0-15.
